headline: 给冻结大模型外挂力觉，零训练搞定接触操作
title_en: ForceHarness: Force Feedback for Frozen Frontier Models Without Training
tagline_en: A harness that lets API-only frozen multimodal models use force feedback zero-shot, no demos or finetuning.
summary_md: ForceHarness is a paper by Ke Sun, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Yike Zhang, Yanzhe Chen, and Mike Zheng Shou about giving frozen, API-only multimodal models a sense of touch. Frontier models can already control robots zero-shot from images, but many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that cameras cannot see. The paper identifies two problems: contact dynamics evolve much faster than an API model can respond, and a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams. ForceHarness solves the first with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force locally and return at contact events, and the second with a physics translation layer that converts each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. The authors also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables, and report that on a real arm without a wrist force sensor, zero-shot success of GPT-6 Astra rises from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation it adds 17.5 points on ForceBench and 34.3 points on HiddenPhys. A key takeaway from ablations: smaller models make better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values. Note: the abstract mentions GPT-6 Astra and an arXiv ID that appear beyond current reality, so verify authenticity. No license is stated; code availability is unclear. Real-arm experiments need a specific arm and force sensor, so newcomers cannot reproduce them.

pick.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
pick.one_liner: 给冻结的多模态大模型外挂力觉闭环，不用训练就能完成接触类操作
pick.one_liner_en: A harness that lets frozen multimodal models use force feedback for contact-rich manipulation without fine-tuning.
pick.how_to_try: 在 MuJoCo 里跑 HiddenPhys / ForceBench 仿真复现；真机实验没硬件做不了。Mac 上可跑小规模仿真，但大模型 API 需自备。
pick.how_to_try_en: Run HiddenPhys/ForceBench in MuJoCo on your Mac to reproduce sim results; real-arm experiments need hardware you don't have.
pick.reason: 问题实在（图像看不到接触力），思路清晰可迁移；但热度与真实性信号弱，真机部分门槛高，适合讲概念不适合上手。
red_flags: 摘要提到 GPT-6 Astra、arXiv 编号 2611 等超出当前现实的信息，需核实真实性
许可证未标注，代码开放程度存疑
真机实验依赖特定机械臂与力传感器，新人无法复现

top.title: HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero
top.one_liner: 一个小巧的视觉-语言-动作模型，在普通电脑上就能跑起来操控机器人。
top.one_liner_en: A compact vision-language-action model that can run on consumer hardware.
top.how_to_try: 用 LeRobot 在 Mac 上加载该权重，接 LIBERO 仿真跑推理；没有真机也能看策略输出
top.how_to_try_en: Load the weights with LeRobot on Mac, run inference in LIBERO sim; works without a real robot.
top.reason: SmolVLA 官方权重，Apache 开源、下载量大，是入门 VLA 与 LeRobot 的好材料；但缺演示，需自己搭仿真。
red_flags: README 训练示例仍写 policy.type=act，与实际 smolvla 权重不一致
Mac 上跑仿真推理需装 MuJoCo/LIBERO，16GB 内存可能吃紧
只给权重卡，缺演示视频与具体评测数字

top.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
top.one_liner: 新基准测试视频世界模型生成场景是否稳固、动作是否连贯
top.one_liner_en: A new benchmark testing whether video world models keep scenes rigid and actions consistent
top.how_to_try: 用GitHub上公开的评测代码和数据，在Mac上给已有开源模型生成的视频打分，无需训练。
top.how_to_try_en: Run the public eval code on released generated videos on your Mac; no training or GPU needed.
top.reason: 评测视角新颖，能揭示现有视频世界模型的场景变形问题，代码数据公开且Mac可跑评测，但贡献限于基准本身。
red_flags: 只有评测基准，无新模型或新方法
arXiv编号与日期可疑，需核实真实性

top.title: yzytz17/1.5-joint-module
top.one_liner: 用1.5美元电路板加3D打印齿轮，做出便宜到极点的机器人关节
top.one_liner_en: A $1.5 FOC board plus a 3D-printed gearbox makes a super-cheap robot joint
top.how_to_try: 需3D打印、买1503电机和打样PCB；Mac只能看CAD与固件，无仿真可跑
top.how_to_try_en: Needs 3D printing, a 1503 motor and a fabricated PCB; on a Mac you can only read the CAD and firmware, no sim.
top.reason: 低成本关节方向有价值且全开源，但半成品、缺闭环验证、需硬件才能玩，对无设备新人只能当读物。
red_flags: 仓库自认未完成，多处TODO和占位数据
视频只在百度网盘，海外难访问
只有开环驱动固件，闭环精度未验证
无NVIDIA或机器人者几乎无法亲手复现

top.title: Huy-Quang-Dao/instantTrack
top.one_liner: 用可微分世界模型让机器人3分钟学会全部40段全身动作
top.one_liner_en: Trains a Unitree G1 whole-body motion-tracking policy in ~3 minutes on one GPU via differentiable world model
top.how_to_try: 需 NVIDIA 显卡跑 mjlab/MuJoCo Warp 训练，Mac 上跑不了；可先看仓库 media 里的对比视频理解。
top.how_to_try_en: Training needs an NVIDIA GPU via mjlab/MuJoCo Warp, so a Mac can't run it; start by watching the comparison videos in media/.
top.reason: 训练加速有真进步、代码 MIT 全开源、学习价值高；但对无硬件新人难以亲手复现，仅能看视频。
red_flags: 需 RTX 5090 级别 GPU，Mac 16GB 无法跑训练
作者匿名、论文未发表，性能数字为自测
RTX 5090 型号疑为笔误，时间数字有自我更正
